title: ext.agentops of AER records written by the agentops.trace mapper (C.10; D.18.3; closed member list)
description: Verbatim AgentOps-Bench fields without a core slot, and the mapper's recorded checks (join, payload suffix). Values copied from the source are untrusted, open JSON; the member names are closed. Not a published corpus schema in v0.1 (AD-10 row 13).

label_facets.description: execution: the member label's facets (D.18.1), the logical identity of the run

totals.description: execution: trace.total_input_tokens, total_output_tokens and total_cost_usd verbatim

wall_time_seconds.description: run scope: trace.wall_time_seconds verbatim (no clock asserted, agentops.duration_no_clock@1)

task_fields.description: task_prompt fixture: difficulty, optimal_steps, tags and tools_available of the joined task

at.description: injection_payload fixture: the step and result index it was recorded on

latency_ms.description: tool_execution or fault decision: latency_ms verbatim (a constant for an injected failure)

injected_failure.description: fault decision: the failure mode verbatim

payload_fixture.description: payload decision: the injection_payload fixture it inserted

suffix_offset.description: payload decision: the character offset of the two newlines before the payload (agentops.payload_suffix@1); after a redaction of the result, the offset in the redacted text (D-608)

redacted.description: tool message: the pointers a profile redaction rule rewrote and the rule (<profile>@<version>#<rule id>; agentops.value_redacted@1, D-608)
